diagnostics.title: OTLP trace exporter disabled (target refused)
diagnostics.summary: The host refused the OTLP exporter's first export to the configured collector (its egress class does not allow the target, or no connector is armed), so trace export to it is disabled and no spans are delivered.
diagnostics.action: Fix the exporter's `url` so the host's egress policy admits the collector, then restart or reload to re-enable export.

diagnostics.title: OTLP collector answered non-2xx (batch dropped)
diagnostics.summary: The collector answered an OTLP export with a non-2xx status, so that batch of spans was dropped (exports are not retried).
diagnostics.action: Check the collector's health and that the configured `url` path and credentials are accepted; the line names the status.

diagnostics.title: OTLP export failed in transport (batch dropped)
diagnostics.summary: An OTLP export did not reach the collector (connection, timeout, DNS or TLS failure), so that batch of spans was dropped (exports are not retried).
diagnostics.action: Check the collector's reachability from the busbar host and the configured `url`; the line names the error.

diagnostics.title: OTLP collector rejected part of a batch
diagnostics.summary: The collector accepted an OTLP export but its partial_success reply rejected some spans, which are lost.
diagnostics.action: Read the collector's message on the line (the rejected count and reason) and fix what it rejects, such as span age or attributes.

diagnostics.title: OTLP exporter skipped a trace record
diagnostics.summary: A line of the traces stream was not exported because it is not JSON or carries no span identity (trace and span ids), so that span is missing from the collector.
diagnostics.action: Check what writes the traces stream; every record must be a JSON object with trace and span ids.
